source_quotes.english: Conjecture: The number of nonzero entries of the LR coefficient table (c^ν_{λμ})_{λ,μ,ν ⊢ n} is asymptotically c·4^n/n^{5/4} (a density estimate for LR-realizable triples among all 4^n configurations).
source_quotes.chinese: 猜想：LR 系数表 (c^ν_{λμ})_{λ,μ,ν ⊢ n} 的非零项总数渐近为 c·4^n/n^{5/4}(指数 4^n 中 LR 可实现三元组的密度估计)。

resolved_semantics.index_parameter: n ranges through the nonnegative integers and tends to positive infinity. Restricting the limit expression to n >= 1 merely makes its denominator defined and does not alter an asymptotic assertion.
resolved_semantics.complete_index_domain: The literal conventional reading of λ,μ,ν ⊢ n is that each of λ, μ and ν separately is an integer partition of the same n. The table ranges over every ordered triple in Part(n) × Part(n) × Part(n). A partition can faithfully be represented by a finite nonincreasing list of positive integers with sum n, with the empty partition at n = 0, or an equivalent conventional representation.
resolved_semantics.forbidden_index_repairs: Do not replace the displayed domain by a combined-size condition, partitions of different displayed integers, a bounded-size domain, a shape inside an unstated box, or a quotient that identifies the two lower indices. Such replacements change the source rather than explain its notation.
resolved_semantics.named_coefficients: LR conventionally means Littlewood–Richardson coefficients. A standard precise definition on arbitrary partition triples is the coefficient of the Schur function s_ν in the Schur-basis expansion of s_λ s_μ in the ring of symmetric functions. An equivalent fully specified Littlewood–Richardson tableau definition is also faithful. The named coefficients are not arbitrary numerical data chosen to satisfy convenient properties.
resolved_semantics.coefficient_definition_obligations: A future author must define actual integer partitions and actual Littlewood–Richardson coefficients for every triple used in the displayed table. A Schur-based development must supply the relevant symmetric-function objects, Schur basis and coefficient extraction. A tableau-based development must supply the shapes, fillings/content and Littlewood–Richardson conditions, including behavior for every displayed triple. If an implementation uses a convention first stated only for a restricted domain, it must supply and justify its extension to the source domain using the standard objects. Any alternative representation must be connected to the conventional coefficients; a surrogate function with merely assumed properties is insufficient.
resolved_semantics.nonzero_count: For each n, N(n) is the finite cardinality of {(λ,μ,ν) in Part(n)^3 : c^ν_{λμ} ≠ 0}. Each indexed entry contributes one, regardless of coefficient magnitude. No unmentioned identification of entries or weighting is permitted.
resolved_semantics.asymptotic_relation: The main clause conventionally asserts the existence of a finite positive real constant c, independent of n, such that N(n)/(c * 4^n / n^(5/4)) tends to 1 as positive integers n tend to infinity. Equivalently, N(n) * n^(5/4) / 4^n tends to c with c > 0. This is asymptotic equivalence, not only an upper bound, an order-of-growth bound or an unspecified density comparison.
resolved_semantics.leading_constant: The unnamed c is an existential positive leading constant, not a Littlewood–Richardson coefficient and not a parameter allowed to depend on n. Positivity and nonzero size are part of the conventional leading-term reading of this nonnegative counting asymptotic; admitting c = 0 or allowing c(n) would change the assertion.
resolved_semantics.exponents: 4^n is the exponential with fixed base 4 and integer exponent n. n^{5/4} is the positive real power with rational exponent 5/4 in the denominator, equivalently a factor n^(-5/4). It must not be parsed as integer division in the exponent or as n^5 divided by 4. The 4^n inside the parenthetical denotes the same displayed exponential scale; it supplies no definition of a configuration.

unresolved_full_statement.material_ambiguity: The English parenthetical refers to a universe of configurations with the phrase “among all 4^n configurations”, but neither the assertion nor either guide defines a configuration, identifies such a universe, or describes how the indexed triples are realized in it. The Chinese parenthetical also supplies no such definition and does not settle the English phrase’s status.
unresolved_full_statement.parenthetical_status: It may be an informal gloss describing normalization by the exponential scale 4^n, or it may assert an additional combinatorial interpretation of the count as a density in an ambient family of 4^n configurations. Parentheses do not themselves decide that question. On the first reading the main clause already fixes the quantitative claim; on the second reading the additional objects and realization relation remain unspecified.
unresolved_full_statement.reason_for_defer: A source-only gate for the complete assertion cannot certify that omitting the ambient-family language preserves every intended requirement, and it cannot construct an unstated family or realization relation. The main asymptotic clause is conventionally precise; this decision does not treat the standard name LR or the displayed index domain as undefined.
unresolved_full_statement.clarification_required: Clarify whether the parenthetical is only explanatory language for the explicitly indexed count and its displayed normalization, or whether it imposes an additional requirement. If it imposes a requirement, identify the configurations and the precise relation between them and the indexed LR-realizable triples. This clarification must come from the statement’s source/maintainer, not from a solver’s convenience.

Establish all properties used about those actual objects within the checked development or its accepted foundations, rather than making conjecture-specific assumptions.
Express the precise existential positive-constant asymptotic assertion, or its logical negation if that is the submitted conclusion, for the cardinality of exactly the source-indexed nonzero entries.
Resolve and honor the parenthetical’s clarified semantic status before authoring a claim that purports to cover the entire original assertion.
